Distributor Collaboration and Support Overview # How does YOHO ensure the stability of product supply? # YOHO maintains strict control over in-house safety inventory levels to guarantee a consistent supply of raw materials. Once a contract is finalized, a detailed production plan and delivery schedule are provided to serve as the foundation for production arrangements. Distributors also have the option to negotiate an inventory stocking mechanism to address unexpected demand fluctuations.
What is the policy on price adjustments? How does YOHO respond to market fluctuations? # Distributors are notified at least one month in advance of any price changes. If raw material costs increase by up to 8%, YOHO absorbs the additional expense and continuously monitors market trends for raw material prices.
Is there an opportunity for exclusive distribution rights in the market? What are the conditions? # YOHO may grant exclusive distribution rights in specific regions, depending on the distributor’s market development capabilities and performance. Typically, this requires a commitment to a certain sales volume or marketing investment, with all terms clearly specified in the contract.
Can distributors participate in the product development or improvement process? # Distributors are encouraged to provide feedback on product design or feature enhancements based on market demand, contributing to ongoing product improvement.
What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for orders? Can it be adjusted flexibly? # A minimum order quantity is generally set to ensure production efficiency. However, YOHO offers flexibility, allowing distributors to negotiate adjustments, especially when launching new products or entering new markets.
What is the policy for product returns or exchanges? # Return or exchange policies are typically defined by the manufacturer and must be clearly outlined in the contract. Distributors should pay attention to specific terms, such as deadlines, product condition requirements, and any applicable fees.
What support is available for marketing campaigns and brand promotion? # YOHO provides marketing materials to assist distributors in boosting sales. The company may also participate in distributors’ marketing activities, offering subsidies or promotional support to enhance product visibility and sales in local markets.
Are there exclusive promo programs or discount policies? # Distributors can benefit from exclusive promotional programs, including quarterly discounts, bulk purchase incentives, product trials, or display plans. Specific promotional activities can be discussed with YOHO to enhance market competitiveness.
Can YOHO provide product training and technical support? # YOHO offers product knowledge training to help distributors and their teams better understand product functions and features.
How to handle requests for customized products? # YOHO can customize products according to the requirements of a distributor’s customer. This typically involves a minimum order quantity and extended delivery time. All processes and timelines should be discussed and confirmed with YOHO in advance.
How are product packaging and logistics support arranged? # Standardized product packaging and logistics solutions are provided by YOHO. Distributors are responsible for ensuring that packaging standards meet local market requirements. Any specific packaging or logistics needs should be discussed with YOHO in advance to ensure compliance.
How are responsibilities for after-sales service and warranty allocated? # YOHO generally provides product warranty and technical support, while the distributor is responsible for the initial coordination of after-sales service.
How does YOHO handle product quality complaints from customers? # YOHO works closely with distributors to address quality complaints. This includes providing product inspection reports and solutions such as replacements or returns, as well as establishing an effective customer feedback management system to resolve issues promptly and protect the brand’s reputation.

Introduction to OEM/ODM Collaboration at YOHO Medical # At YOHO Medical, we strive to streamline the process for clients interested in OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) services. Our approach is designed to gather essential information upfront, ensuring a smooth and efficient initial assessment of your project needs.
Understanding OEM and ODM Services # OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer): The customer provides the product design, and YOHO Medical manages the manufacturing process. ODM (Original Design Manufacturer): YOHO Medical handles both the design and production, allowing customers to customize and apply their own branding. Key Information for Collaboration # To facilitate a successful partnership, we request the following details from prospective clients:
Company Information:
Company name Contact person Phone number Email address Company website or social media links Company address Service Requirements:
Selection of OEM or ODM service Product category (e.g., masks, wipes, etc.) Brief description of the product to be developed or manufactured Estimated demand volume (options include fewer than 1,000 units, 1,000–10,000 units, 10,000–50,000 units, or more than 50,000 units) Target market or region (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific) Product design status (complete design/specifications, need for design assistance, or modifications to an existing design) Specific product certification requirements (such as CE, FCC, RoHS, etc.) Expected delivery date or production timeline Budget range (optional) Any special requirements or additional information Next Steps # Once the preliminary information is submitted, our team will review your requirements and reach out to discuss further details and potential collaboration. For any specific requests or adjustments, we encourage direct contact with YOHO Medical.

End-to-End OEM/ODM Project Management at YOHO # At YOHO, we are dedicated to providing a seamless and professional OEM/ODM experience, guiding our clients through every stage of the process. Our structured workflow ensures that each project is handled with precision, transparency, and a focus on quality and timely delivery.
Our Service Process # Step 01: Requirement Analysis
We begin by gathering specific requirements from our clients, such as product type, size, and intended purpose. A preliminary evaluation is conducted to assess feasibility and technical considerations. Step 02: Product Design
Our design team develops product concepts tailored to the client’s specifications. Design sketches are prepared and submitted for client review and feedback. Step 03: Packaging and Labeling
Packaging solutions are created based on client needs, ensuring both functionality and brand alignment. Packaging samples are produced and presented for client approval. Step 04: Sample-Making
An initial product sample is manufactured according to the agreed design. The sample is provided to the client for thorough evaluation and confirmation. Step 05: Material Procurement
Upon final sample approval, we source high-quality raw materials that meet established standards. Our procurement process emphasizes reliability and compliance with client requirements. Step 06: Mass Production
Mass production commences following sample confirmation. We maintain strict oversight of the production process to uphold product quality and consistency. Step 07: Quality Control
Continuous monitoring is implemented throughout production, with multi-stage inspections. This includes raw material checks, in-process inspections, and final product assessments to ensure excellence. Step 08: Shipping and Logistics
We coordinate logistics to guarantee safe and timely delivery of finished products. Clients benefit from logistics tracking services for full transparency. Step 09: After-Sales Service
Comprehensive after-sales support is available to address any client concerns. We actively seek and integrate customer feedback to drive ongoing product improvement.
